❯ /tour https://github.com/acme/shop/pull/7 (you are the tour agent of this PR, started by the guided-review app because the reviewer picked it and it has no tour). Only the listed
tools are allowed and anything else is denied, never asked: run one command per Bash call, with the PR url written out, without shell variables, pipes, `&&`, `;` or `$(...)`. The Write tool makes the
tour's folder. When `guided-review check https://github.com/acme/shop/pull/7` is clean, run `guided-review open https://github.com/acme/shop/pull/7`, which shows
the tour to the reviewer. Afterwards the reviewer's comments reach you here as messages: answer each as its message says, fix the tour when a comment shows it is wrong, and never change the PR's
code.

  Ran 3 shell commands

⏺ I could not make the tour, because the guided-review command does not exist here.

  What I did:
  - I read the PR: https://github.com/acme/shop/pull/7
  - I ran guided-review outline and guided-review tour-path. Both failed with command not found: guided-review.

  Why I stopped: The tour needs that command to:
  - list the PR's changes,
  - find where to save the tour file,
  - check the tour,
  - open it in the app.

  I can only run the commands the app allows, so I cannot search for the tool myself.

  What you do now:
  1. Find out where guided-review is installed. Then add that folder to the PATH that this session gets. (PATH is the list of folders the shell looks in for commands.)
  2. Start the tour again from the app.
